scheduleHistory.runningDescription: This shift already owns a production run. Continue floor work from the production board.
scheduleHistory.completeDescription: Its accepted plan and production record are preserved. Start the waiting orders in a new shift.
scheduleHistory.closedDescription: Closed shifts are read-only. Plan a new shift for the waiting orders.
scheduleHistory.endedDescription: It can no longer be computed, accepted, or started. Plan a new shift for the waiting orders.

scheduling.managerRequired: An owner or administrator must advance this plan.
scheduling.warningShiftOverflowDetail: The projected finish is after the shift ends. Confirm this warning before accepting the plan, or edit the shift and recompute.
scheduling.warningOversizedDetail_one: {{count}} whole order exceeds the current pulse capacity and is not included in the proposed batches. Correct intake if its weight is wrong, or increase tested capacity and recompute.
scheduling.warningOversizedDetail_other: {{count}} whole orders exceed the current pulse capacity and are not included in the proposed batches. Correct intake if a weight is wrong, or increase tested capacity and recompute.
scheduling.warningNoWashersDetail: No active washer can carry production. Add or activate compatible washer capacity in Configuration, then recompute the plan.
scheduling.warningNoDryersDetail: No active dryer can carry production. Add or activate compatible dryer capacity in Configuration, then recompute the plan.
scheduling.warningNoFoldingDetail: The folding team provides no capacity for this shift. Set a positive folding-team count, then recompute the plan.
scheduling.warningsAcknowledged: Warnings acknowledged with the accepted plan.
scheduling.acknowledgeWarnings: I acknowledge the blocking schedule warnings shown above.
scheduling.timelineDescription: Whole orders stay together through four equal {{minutes}}-minute stages.
scheduling.noPlanDescription: Compute the schedule above to build the production timeline.
scheduling.noBatches: This proposal has no production batches.
scheduling.demandRemains: Planned demand remains visible in the timeline above.
scheduling.configurationDescription: Scheduling uses the floor-tested pulse published in Configuration.
scheduling.recomputeDescription: Shift settings, order priority, or ready demand changed after this plan was computed.
scheduling.startDescription: Starting creates the production run after one final server check.
scheduling.acceptDescription: Review the timeline and warnings, then save this plan as the shift preference.
scheduling.buildDescription: Compute one proposal from every eligible order.
scheduling.publishBeforeComputing: Publish a production configuration before computing.
scheduling.positiveFolders: Enter a positive folder count before computing.
scheduling.endAfterStart: Shift end must be after shift start.

errors.shiftChanged: Shift settings changed after this page loaded. The latest shift has been loaded; review it before continuing.
errors.shiftStarted: This shift has already started and its time window can no longer be edited.
errors.shiftClosed: This shift is closed. Create a new shift for the waiting orders.
errors.shiftEnded: This shift has ended. Create a new shift before computing or starting production.
errors.shiftNotStarted: Production cannot start before the shift begins. Wait until the shift start time or edit the shift.
errors.shiftWindowInvalid: The server rejected this shift window. Confirm the local date, start time, end time, and timezone.
errors.configurationInvalid: The published production configuration is no longer valid. Open Configuration and publish a tested pulse.
errors.planStale: This plan is no longer current. Recompute it, then review the new timeline before continuing.
errors.demandChanged: Ready orders or shift settings changed after this plan was computed. Recompute the schedule before continuing.
errors.acceptBeforeStart: Accept the current plan before starting production.
errors.warningsRequired: Acknowledge every blocking warning shown in this plan before accepting it.
errors.warningsChanged: The blocking warnings changed. Recompute and review the current warnings before accepting.
errors.noBatches: This plan has no production batches. Make at least one order eligible, then recompute before starting.
errors.productionAlreadyStarted: Production has already started for this shift. Open Production to continue floor work.
errors.priorityChanged: This order changed before its priority was saved. The current order list has been loaded; review it and try again.
errors.notFound: This shift or plan no longer exists. Refresh Schedule and create a current plan.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again before continuing.
errors.forbidden: Your account cannot change this schedule. Ask an owner or administrator to complete the action.
errors.unavailable: Schedule cannot reach the production service. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalidResponse: The production service returned schedule data that Processor could not read. Refresh before continuing.
errors.computeFailed: The schedule was not computed. Review the shift window, eligible orders, and published configuration before trying again.
errors.priorityFailed: Processor could not confirm the priority change. Refresh the order list before trying again.
errors.acceptFailed: The plan was not accepted. Recompute if production inputs changed, then review and accept the current plan.
errors.startUnknown: Processor could not confirm whether production started. Refresh and check Production before trying again.
